text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today's rival is Mejiro Bright! Standing 
before me as the representative of the 
Mejiro family! But—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A race is a lonely showdown! The strong 
fight on their own without relying on 
family. So, who's gonna shine the 
brightest today? —It's me!
